verdict.rationale: Fly.io runs standard Docker images, deploys from your existing project source directory, and offers framework-specific docs, so existing framework and container workflows carry over. However, deployment is centered on its own flyctl CLI (`fly launch`), and nothing in the evidence covers Git-push, CI-pipeline, or editor integration. missing for 10: documented Git/CI integration (e.g. deploying from existing CI pipelines), editor workflow support, evidence that deployment works without the proprietary flyctl tooling, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep using my existing Git, CI, editor, and framework workflows without adopting proprietary tooling

citations.quote: Fly.io converts Docker images to fast-booting VMs and runs them globally.
Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
Check out the docs specific to your tech so you can move faster.
